title: BAFF C
description:
BAFF C is a hardcore 2D minimalist avoid-em-up puzzle game that tests your precision, reflexes, and patience. Guide a mysterious eye through 50 challenging levels, collect crystals, and navigate dangerous environments filled with walls and traps.

Collect Crystals. Unlock the Portal.Your mission is to collect every crystal without touching walls or falling into traps. Once all crystals are collected, the exit portal activates, allowing you to advance to the next level.

Study each layout, plan a safe route, and carefully navigate around obstacles. A single mistake can end your attempt, making precise movement essential.

Simple Concept. Hardcore Difficulty.BAFF C combines straightforward gameplay with demanding obstacle-avoidance challenges.

Navigate narrow passages, anticipate hazards, and maintain accurate control while collecting crystals. Success requires concentration, hand-eye coordination, and careful timing.

A built-in timer lets you track your progress as you refine your skills and overcome difficult sections.

50 Levels of Minimalist ChallengesExplore 50 levels featuring different layouts, traps, and crystal-collecting objectives.

The clean minimalist 2D graphics keep your attention on navigation and precision. Learn from unsuccessful attempts, improve your accuracy, and master each challenge through practice.

Key Features• 50 challenging levels – Navigate hazardous environments and complete precision-based objectives.

• Hardcore avoid-em-up gameplay – Avoid dangerous walls and traps.

• Eye-controlled gameplay – Guide an eye safely through challenging layouts.

• Crystal collection – Gather every crystal to activate the exit portal.

• Precision challenges – Test your reflexes, timing, and hand-eye coordination.

• Route planning – Find safe paths between obstacles and collectibles.

• Timer – Track your progress during gameplay.

• Minimalist 2D graphics – Clean, abstract visuals focused on gameplay.

• 100 Steam Achievements – Unlock achievements as you progress.

• Steam Cloud support – Synchronize supported game progress.

• Single-player experience – Complete every challenge through practice and concentration.

Collect the crystals. Avoid the traps. Activate the portal. Can you master all 50 levels of BAFF C?
description_short: BAFF C is a hardcore 2D minimalist avoid-em-up puzzle game. Guide an eye through 50 trap-filled levels, collect every crystal to activate the exit portal, and avoid deadly walls and obstacles. Plan safe routes, test your reflexes and timing, and master precise movement.
